title: Wire format for signing in through an external OpenID Connect provider
spec: Opening tag 37 BeginExternal has no payload (trailing bytes refused). Reply tag 166 ExternalStart carries issuer (1..2048 bytes), client id (1..256), authorization endpoint (1..2048) and a 43-character nonce of the session-token shape, each a u16 big-endian length and UTF-8. Opening tag 38 FinishExternal carries the authorization code (1..2048 printable ASCII), the PKCE verifier (43..128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~, RFC 7636) and the redirect URI (1..256 printable ASCII), each a u16 length and the bytes; bad shapes are FieldLength on encode and decode, every prefix fails, trailing bytes are refused. Debug never shows the code, the verifier or the nonce. Until a server has an identity provider, it answers both new openings with the same Refused as a failed sign-in; the app treats an ExternalStart answer to any other opening as a protocol error.
